description: This file defines the class Kint_Parsers_FsPath, which extends a parser class to handle filesystem path variables. It includes logic to determine the file type, permissions, size, and other attributes of a path string if it points to a readable file, directory, or special file type.

classes.name: Kint_Parsers_FsPath
classes.description: A parser class for filesystem path variables, providing detailed file attribute extraction.

methods.name: _parse
methods.description: Parses a variable to determine if it is a readable path and extracts file information such as type, permissions, size, etc.
